title: Company Brain
description: A recursive tree. Every node needs only a title. Depth 1 = lenses (the toggle), depth 2 = brain regions, deeper = hot-spots inside their parent, leaves = single neurons.

description.description: One plain-English line. Shown on the card.

value.description: Headline figure shown on the card, e.g. "65K" or "38 people". Falls back to the child count.

color.description: Children inherit as tints when unset.

region.description: Placement hint for depth-2 nodes. Unset = auto.
